events.title: Demo update: watch your hole change colour as it grows
events.summary: Thank you to everyone playing the demo during Next Fest. A common note from playtesters: it was hard to tell when the hole had grown big enough to eat the next kind of matter. This update answers that, and fixes a few things you reported.A new colour for every new mealEach time your hole grows big enough to eat a new kind of matter, the camera pulls back with a small jolt and the glowing ring around the hole takes a new colour. events.title: The free Infall demo is out now, and the game launches November 10
events.summary: The free demo of Infall is live: play it on Steam.It is the opening of the game. You start smaller than the dust around you, swallow your way through dust and comets, and buy your first abilities from the upgrade tree. It takes about fifteen minutes, and when the demo tree is done, the full game carries on from there.Infall launches November 10, 2026.
